source: Master3s2 final activated residual board immediately before hw/hb. Read from original source forward by returning its existing local h. Use true tracker seat-visible trajectory, historical actions only. Compare both heads recovered cellwise, all full raw logits and existing raw-policy probabilities.

config.source: Freeze before labels, fitting, or any held decision read. Starting parameters for both arms are Sapling master6_actor_v1.npz f82bfd47a904aa1fbfa4e95fbfcdd13e623c1f1eb216a8e736694a1d282cc713; exact int8 deployment compare.
config.objective: Student cross-entropy to temperature-1 projected Master3s2 raw pre-search spatial policy. Control cross-entropy to argmax of the very same projected legal vector. On both arms keep the same shard order, batch order, optimizer, initialization, actual forward decoder prefix, legality mask and active (at least two legal actions) loss denominator. Source-executed action agreement is reported only, never used as training target; source orders in the historical-prefix mode have already formed that prefix.
config.exposure: Each draw round shuffles terrains then draws from each terrain's shuffled rows without replacement until exhausted; both modes and domains retained. Each optimizer spends 256 root presentations. 512 combined.
config.parameters: Train all shared spatial, token, attention, context, GRU and policy scoring parameters; omit only aux carbon and scalar/utility/WDL/margin heads from optimization. Unused style rows may still change by AdamW decay.
config.eligibility: Benchmark on int8 public-prefix legal policy distributions. Require terrain-equal mean student KL to target lower than both control and parent on all held observed slots and strictly lower on at least half of held terrains against matched control. Require held native original executed legal-slot agreement within two percentage points of parent on recorded-prefix roots. Require actual normal-entry qualification separately. This only screens for a future diagnostic, never authorizes a native match automatically.

treatment: Identical standalone soft-target training with coefficient .10 times float32 MSE between channel-standardized projected Sapling trunk and target board per cell, centered across all channels with variance +1e-5. One shared training-only 1x1 affine from final Sapling board after all residual/spatial attentions to physical Master3s2 board channels, projected on canonical spatial indices. Same exact data, seed, 32x8 order and optimizer; no change to stored or deployed actor architecture.
fit_scope: Feature extraction from original source on 44 map/seats; 18 physical training maps, 10 reused held maps. For seat zero preserve physical grid; seat one mirror columns, check all coordinate and worker-logit mappings. No family trial or tuning.
evaluation: Compare only against matched soft-policy student, quantized. Gate all: lower held equal-terrain teacher KL; improved free-choice emitted action agreement against actual original Master3s2 orders on 5 held original-side maps (prefix legality in BOTH emitted policies; ambiguous/forced excluded); at least 3/5 positive map deltas; no seat aggregation with negative mean change. Report parent separately, both seats, and projected features fit vs held with frozen eval-only null. No new map; native response on already exposed roots only after entire gate passes. True game utility and survival require separate measurements.
